description: This file defines API handlers for exporting and importing board and team archives in the Focalboard application, including route registration and permission checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler struct for focalboard server API endpoints related to archive import/export.

methods.name: registerAchivesRoutes
methods.description: Registers archive-related routes to the provided mux router.

methods.name: handleArchiveExportBoard
methods.description: Handles exporting a single board's archive, with permission checks and response headers set for binary download.

methods.name: handleArchiveImport
methods.description: Handles importing an archive into a team, with permission and guest checks, processing uploaded file.

methods.name: handleArchiveExportTeam
methods.description: Handles exporting all boards in a team as an archive, with permission checks and response headers for binary download.
